title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $300 on Ecovacs Deebot X11 Pro
excerpt: There's nothing like a best-ever deal.
content_html:
SAVE $300: As of Aug. 5, the EcoVacs Deebot X11 Pro robot vacuum is on sale for $699.99 at Amazon. That's a 30% discount on the list price.

Credit: Ecovacs

$699.99 at Amazon
$999.99 Save $300

The EcoVacs Deebot X11 Pro robot vacuum is back on sale on Amazon, and this time it's at a record-low price. As of Aug. 5, this robot vacuum is down from $999.99 to $699.99, saving you $300. According to price tracking by camelcamelcamel, this is the lowest price it has ever been.

So, what are you getting in addition to your $300 discount? This robot vacuum combines both vacuuming and mopping technology to tackle everyday dirt, spills, and pet hair. It has an OZMO Roller 2.0 that uses a high-density nylon roller with continuous pressurized self-washing to scrub away stubborn messes and dried stains while cleaning with fresh water.

And you won't have to clean awkward corners yourself. The TruEdge 3.0 extends the roller closer to edges and corners for improved coverage, so no spot is missed.
